swap_v2_sheets: edit the SHEETS constant of game/tools/build_mammoth_poses.gd (same cell order assumed), rerun the builder, then `Godot --headless --path game --import` and compare .godot/imported/mammoth-poses.png-*.md5 with md5 of the atlas

frames.player_howdah: walk 8, stop 2, melee 4, hit 2, death 5 (box and gun included; baked rider silhouettes remain until the -v2 empty sheets)
frames.riders: spotter and gunner parts per frame, blue and olive; death 2-5 are merged pairs
frames.dismount: 5 frames per side (stand, leg over, hang, drop, land), rim fragments cut away

scale_method.bare: stop frame bbox height 184 src px = 20.15 logical px, the height of the former pose 8 drawn at the 28 logical px limit (410x295 source); frame is then 28.1 px wide
scale_method.howdah: mean over the 8 walk frames of sqrt(tusk area) ratio to the bare sheet (tusk = largest warm cream blob): player 0.956, enemy 0.918
scale_method.dismount: head-matched to the trooper rig: head height (face bottom to hood top) 62 src px on troopers-concept-v2 x 0.1548 = 9.6 texels; dismount sheet 57 src px -> 0.1683 (standing soldier 11.4 logical px)
scale_method.riders: same head height: gunner of the riders sheet 40 src px -> 0.2399 (the earlier x1.33 was 5.5% larger). Body-matched would be x0.75: tasks/validation/mammoth-rider-scale-20261002.png

pivots: x = mass centre of the frame plus the stopped frame's hoof-minus-mass offset; y = sole (common ground line); GROUND lines of the builder print each frame's gap to its row's median sole

stride.note: per frame change the pair of planted hooves nearest the mean advance is matched; each frame is drawn shifted so the matched hoof keeps its world x (builder WOBBLE: body bob up to 0.54/0.91/0.67 px bare/player/enemy), body advances at the mean (3.4/6.1/5.0 px per cycle). Measured by test_tactical_actor_motion: 0.00 px planted-hoof move on every frame change (113 in the walk, 24/24 table transitions).

known_limits: rider fall: ballistic (g 200, lift 24 px/s, drift 11 px/s), the single faller lies as the trooper's lying sprite; death of the beast with riders launches them from the tilting howdah
gait: stride 3.4-6.1 px per cycle at 14 px/s plays 2-4 cycles/s (Codex's frames do not encode a longer stride)
howdah sheets: the empty rear seat has a dark cushion/seat-back lump; Codex says no rider silhouettes remain, no -v2
